evals.prompt: Scaffold a new .NET library solution named MyLibrary with root namespace Acme and the default target frameworks.
evals.expected_output: A single-project library scaffold with PROJECT_NAME-based paths, NuGet package metadata, DocFX files, and resolved package versions.
expectations: Uses {PROJECT_NAME} as the default packable project name
Resolves package-specific version placeholders from NuGet before writing Directory.Packages.props
Creates DocFX config using {DOCFX_TARGET_FRAMEWORK} rather than a hardcoded net10.0

evals.prompt: Create a library solution named SavvyIo under the root namespace Codebelt with benchmark runner project name benchmark-runner and target frameworks net10.0;net8.0.
evals.expected_output: A scaffold that keeps the wildcard benchmark runner project reference, generates benchmark jobs from the selected TFMs, and writes PROJECT_NAME-based project references.
expectations: Preserves the wildcard ProjectReference in benchmark-runner.csproj
Uses PROJECT_NAME in benchmark and test project references to src
Generates BENCHMARK_RUNTIME_JOBS from the selected executable TFMs

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new library for an individual maintainer and keep the repository URL as the package project URL unless I override it.
evals.expected_output: A scaffold that carries the repository URL through as the recommended package project URL, uses COMPANY_OR_PERSON in DocFX branding, and includes the shared .bot asset.
expectations: Uses COMPANY_OR_PERSON in DocFX metadata instead of a separate COMPANY placeholder
Copies assets/shared/.bot/README.md into the generated repo
